prompt: A close-up still-life photograph, seen from directly above, of {subject}, filling the middle of a square frame, lying directly on one flat, evenly lit, plain soft blush-pink background (hex #f2dfe1) that is the same colour everywhere: no circle, no disc, no plate, no spotlight, no vignette, no props.
